title: Unchanged action lane reconciliation

effect.user: Actions keep waiting for authoritative completion without repeatedly deriving every sibling view.
assertions: Unchanged polls preserve fresh returned views, state and audit stream.
Completed, failed and missing archive commands still settle and update successor holds.
Changed executor detail is audited; claiming and attempt identity stay unchanged.
State survives reopen; audit replay matches non-corrupt fixtures.

idle.why: No actions means neither method is called.

first-use.why: Initial dispatch is outside the unchanged-poll interval.

repeated.why: Ten unchanged polls for queued/running archive and executor waits.

scale.why: One and 32 actions per lane, three repetitions.

release.why: Fixture stores close after each test; no runtime spawned.

recovery.why: Reopen and settle from current authoritative command state.

fixture.seed: real temporary SQLite store via core test helpers

recipe.readiness: Action dispatched or held; before state and returned view captured.
recipe.completion: Ten polls, state/audit equality and work counter checked.
recipe.teardown: Close fixture store and remove owned temporary directory.

metrics.scope: CoreStore full-lane listActionViews calls in ten unchanged polls
metrics.collector: instance wrapper in actions-noop.test.ts; returned actionView work is not included
metrics.invariant: Every unchanged-poll sample has zero full-lane audit view builds; state, audit and fresh return values match.
metrics.noise: Deterministic counts. Three repetitions; no timing claim.

gaps: One fresh actionView still loads its lane and queue summary.
Whole-daemon CPU, allocation, fsync and request latency are unmeasured.
readiness: 18 deterministic samples prove zero full-lane audit view builds on unchanged polls; transition/reopen controls are tests, total scheduler cost remains unmeasured.
